capabilities: Look up English words with Russian translation, transcription, part of speech and examples
Save word cards as Markdown notes with properties and an index note
Import EPUB, FB2 and PDF books as chapter notes with per-book dictionaries
Add selected words from a book with a link back to the passage
Run 10-20 word quiz sessions (flashcards, multiple choice, typing, gap fill) with SM-2 scheduling
extras: Interface and translations are Russian-only (English to Russian), aimed at Russian speakers. Word lookups require an internet connection and use free external services (Wiktionary, MyMemory with a daily anonymous limit, Free Dictionary API, Tatoeba); no account or API key is needed. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up English words with Russian translations or to drill vocabulary with spaced repetition inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Reviews are scheduled with a simplified SM-2 algorithm (as in Anki)

summary: Vocabulary trainer that looks up English words with Russian translations, builds dictionaries from EPUB/FB2/PDF books, and runs spaced-repetition quizzes.
